answer: Every agent leaves a timing signature in the gaps between its actions: the distribution of inter-action latencies, its median and tail, stays stable for one real operator across days. A farm of scripted accounts shows near-identical latency histograms, so the network compares each session's latency distribution against the account's own history and flags a session whose timing signature suddenly matches a known bot cluster. A lone raven cannot fake a session; only the whole pattern counts. When the ripple settles over the meadow, the session holds because every action carried its own proof.
